name: Trent Kaufman
prior_offices: Converse County commissioner (won the November 2022 general election and was re-elected in 2026)
background: Trent Kaufman is a Converse County commissioner and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. The official commissioners page lists him as a member. The Douglas Budget / WyoRoundup reported that he, Macey Moore, and Cody Torgerson will fill the three open commission seats.

sources.name: Douglas Budget / WyoRoundup, Nov. 3, 2026, Converse County voters pick new leaders in Douglas, Glenrock and Rolling Hills
